metadata.title: Strongly log-concave measures and lattices
metadata.abstract: Let $\Lambda \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a full rank lattice with the property that $\det \Gamma \ge 1$ for all sublattices $\Gamma \subseteq \Lambda^*$. We prove that there exists a symmetric random vector $X \in \mathbb{R}^n$ with a smooth, strictly positive density $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to (0, \infty)$ satisfying that $f$ is $\alpha$-strongly log-concave, where $\alpha = 2\pi/e$, and $X + \Lambda$ is uniform on $\mathbb{R}^n/\Lambda$. Moreover, we show that the existence of such a density $f$ characterizes the assumption on $\Gamma$ up to a constant. There are a few consequences of the above. First, for such lattices we can bound the covering radius \[ \mu(\Lambda, K) = \max_{x \in \mathbb{R}^n} \min_{\lambda \in \Lambda} \|x-\lambda\|_K \le \sqrt{\frac{2e}{\pi}} \cdot \mathbb{E}_G\, \|G\|_K \] of a convex body $K \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ containing $0$ in its interior, where $G \sim N(0,I)$. This implies an $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ bound for the flatness constant and an $O(\log^{3/2} n)$ bound for the subspace flatness constant. Second, we establish as a consequence an alternative proof of the reverse Minkowski theorem with an explicit constant.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 用强对数凹概率密度描述格及其对偶子格的行列式约束，并推出覆盖半径、平坦性和逆 Minkowski 型结论。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造强对数凹常数 2π/e 的密度，使其模格分布均匀；给出覆盖半径的显式高斯估计和平坦性界。
analysis.limitations: 需满足所有对偶子格的行列式下界；部分平坦性阶数与既有结果相同，贡献也包括新方法和显式常数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI Disclosure 明确表示研究发展过程中使用 ChatGPT 5.6 Pro 和 6 Pro，但未细分贡献，不据此推断核心想法或证明归属。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29238v1 · PDF 第 5 页 §1.2 AI Disclosure
